other_height_rules: No BFE (approximate A): lowest floor >= 2 ft above highest adjacent grade. Future-conditions flood hazard areas: RFPE = future-conditions flood elevation + freeboard (definition).

history.quote: Regulatory flood protection elevation means the elevation, in relation to mean sea level, to which the reference level of all structures and other development located within special flood hazard areas must be protected. Where base flood elevations (BFEs) have been determined, this elevation shall be the BFE. [history: (Code 1986, ch. 12, art. IV, div. 2; Ord. No. 05-614, 11-15-2005; Ord. No. 10-820, 3-23-2010)]
